read_header_lines: read MuJoCo C header lines and return a dictionary of parsed ApiDefinition objects
create_api_definition: create an ApiDefinition dataclass instance with token, c_type, code, start, end, section, and doc fields
build_api_state: build an ApiState instance to track parsing state for functions, enums, structs, and documentation
summarize_api_definitions: summarize parsed MuJoCo API definitions including functions, enums, and structs from header files
review_function_parsing: review how the module parses C function definitions, struct definitions, and enum definitions from MuJoCo headers
